messages:
maria: Kicking off a Partner Runway thread — want to align SI enablement milestones for the Q2 SI onboarding pilot. Quick sync?
aj: +1. Goal: cert + lab access + playbooks before pilot. Timeline?
kyle: Thinking a 6-week runway: W1 KT, W2 lab infra & creds, W3 train-the-trainer, W4 cert exam, W5 pilot prep, W6 joint announce / handoff.
sanjay: We need dedicated sandbox creds + a small HW testbed spec for integrator validation. Can infra/partners spin this up? Any IP/network constraints?
maria: Onboarding checklist draft I sketched: access reqs, sample apps, platform tenant, test datasets (PII-scrubbed), eval harness, pass criteria. I'll upload DOC and link in #drive.
alexa: Product marketing: Heads up — avoid conflicting with marketplace launch on May 12. We prefer joint announcement week of May 20. Is that feasible?
aj: May 20 feasible only if certs finished by May 10 and we have recording and cert badge assets ready. Also need partner logos signed off.
kyle: Proposed training format: 2hr live session + 3 hands-on on-demand labs (deploy sample webhook, Dedicated capacity flow, model rollback test). Slide + demo repo + self-cert quiz.

kyle: Quick draft checklist (paste):
```
- Create partner tenant (with SI test account)
- Provision sandbox GPUs (1x A10 / small cluster)
- Seed sample repo (webhook demo + infra as code)
- Provide eval harness + golden prompts
- Schedule 2hr live training + record
- Publish quiz + badge issuance flow
```

sanjay: For hardware partners we need a test matrix: model sizes, batch sizes, quantization settings. I'll draft and ping hw team.
onboard-bot: Created doc: https://drive.redwood/partners/si-runway-v1 (maria uploaded)
maria: Thanks @onboard-bot — doc includes timeline & responsible owners. I added a 'risk & rollback' section for the pilot.
aj: Owners: I'll take certification exam design, kyle takes training content, sanjay owns infra, alexa handles comms. Can each owner drop a short plan by EOD Friday?
alexa: I'll confirm announcement copy & badge visuals by Friday. Need partner logo assets and legal approval (ETA Tue).
kyle: Also recommend a 30-minute office hours slot for week after training for live troubleshooting. Worth adding to the schedule?
maria: Yes add office hours. Let's set the recurring weekly slot for 4 weeks after launch.
aj: Action items summarized:
- aj: cert plan (due Fri)
- kyle: training + repo (due Fri)
- sanjay: infra spec & test matrix (due Fri)
- alexa: comms & assets (due Tue)
- maria: consolidate and schedule office hours + pilot calendar

kyle: Any blockers today?
sanjay: Only open question is hardware partner availability for week2 testing — I'll confirm by EOD.
maria: Great. We'll reconvene Thu 11am PT for a quick sync. Please update the doc before then. :thumbsup:
alexa: 👍
aj: 👍
kyle: 👍
